run.note: Priority full-text batch. Scores are editorial triage and do not publish papers automatically.

candidates.title: tau_0-VLA: a Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with World-Model-Guided Test-Time Computation

asset_checks.note: Official project links the repository; GitHub API retry was interrupted, so it is not counted as API-verified.

embodied_relevance.evidence: Hierarchical VLA performs long-horizon household tasks on AGIBOT G1, ARX AC One and Franka platforms.

primary_source.evidence: Official full text and project page were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Allocates test-time computation at subtask boundaries using predicted visual outcomes, value scoring, reflection and revisable execution memory.

claim_support.evidence: 40,115 hours of heterogeneous real data; four 13-25-step long-horizon tasks; three embodiments; controlled Plan Once, TTC and memory comparisons.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, data, real-robot experiments, ablations and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: 这批最强工作。它把额外推理算力放在稀疏的子任务边界，用世界模型预览候选后果并修正执行记忆；四个真机长任务中分层 Plan Once 平均成功率 45.0%，高于同一低层策略直接执行的 27.5%，TTC 又在三项真机任务上继续提升。
risks_or_uncertainties: 四个长任务每项仅10次真机试验
40,115小时数据构成复杂，外部团队完整复现成本很高
项目资产的API级复核需重试

candidates.title: MANIGUARD: A Benchmark and Data Suite for Specification-Grounded Safety Evaluation and Improvement of Robotic Manipulation

embodied_relevance.evidence: Safety benchmark directly evaluates foundation-model robot manipulation policies under physical constraints.

primary_source.evidence: Official full text, project, code and dataset collection were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Separates safety specifications from task success and monitors LTLf-grounded constraints over physical state.

claim_support.evidence: Six contact-rich families, 200 base tasks, 1,000 locked scenarios, deterministic resets, multiple policies and safety-annotated trajectories.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Benchmark, data pipeline, monitoring, policy evaluation and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: ManiGuard把“完成任务”和“安全完成”拆开，以LTLf约束、自动机监控和确定性复位评测基础模型策略；200个基础任务扩展成1,000个锁定场景，并公开代码与数据套件，适合成为安全评测公共基线。
risks_or_uncertainties: 主要证据来自仿真而非真实机器人伤害/风险场景
安全谓词覆盖仍受人工规格和状态可观测性限制

candidates.title: SoftVTBench: A Deformation-Aware Visuo-Tactile Dataset and Benchmark for Deformable-Object Manipulation

embodied_relevance.evidence: Visuo-tactile dataset and policy benchmark for deformable manipulation.

primary_source.evidence: Official full text, project, code and dataset page were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Pairs policy-visible vision/touch with evaluator-only FEM state and separates task success from deformation-safe success.

claim_support.evidence: 4,000 demonstrations, 50+ assets, rigid twins, four suites and extensive OOD evaluations across policy families.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Dataset construction, policies, metrics, OOD results and sim-to-real limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: SoftVTBench不仅判断软物体任务是否完成，还利用策略不可见的FEM状态评估滑移与过度形变；4,000条示范、50余资产和刚性双胞胎对照使触觉贡献更可诊断，代码与数据入口已出现。
risks_or_uncertainties: 完全基于仿真触觉，论文明确不主张其GelSight信号已通过sim-to-real验证
单一机器人embodiment

candidates.title: HumanoidVLN: A Physics-Grounded Simulator and Benchmark for Vision-Language Navigation Across Diverse Humanoid Embodiments

embodied_relevance.evidence: Physics-grounded VLN simulator evaluates bipedal navigation across four humanoid embodiments.

primary_source.evidence: Official full text and project page were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Adds embodiment-specific biped physics, falls and locomotion-induced camera dynamics absent from wheeled VLN benchmarks.

claim_support.evidence: 87 scenes, 933 episodes, four robots, four VLN models and 20 paired sim-real G1 episodes.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Simulator, curation, benchmark, real correlation and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: HumanoidVLN把VLN从无动力学或轮式代理推进到真实双足约束，覆盖4种人形、87个场景和933条路线，并用20条G1配对轨迹检查仿真—现实相关性。主要扣分来自代码和数据仍为Coming Soon。
risks_or_uncertainties: 代码和数据尚未真实发布
真实验证只有两个场景、20条配对轨迹
人工验证仍是扩展瓶颈

candidates.title: LabDex: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Dexterous Manipulation in Laboratories

asset_checks.note: Repository exists, but project labels code Coming Soon; do not award full code credit.

embodied_relevance.evidence: Real and simulated dexterous manipulation of chemistry labware and long-horizon procedures.

primary_source.evidence: Official full text and project page were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Hierarchical taxonomy connects atomic skills, compositional tasks and complete laboratory workflows across real and simulation platforms.

claim_support.evidence: Cross-level evaluations, 200 demonstrations per task by default and 50 real trials per atomic task reveal composition bottlenecks.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Platforms, dataset, methods, cross-level experiments and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: LabDex把实验室灵巧操作按原子技能、组合技能和长流程组织，并统一真机与仿真任务定义。结果不只给总成功率，还暴露初始抓取和技能过渡是长流程失败的主要瓶颈，数据入口已提供。
risks_or_uncertainties: 项目页仍将代码标为Coming Soon
实验室对象和任务分布较专门
部分长流程评测仍受低层技能失败主导

candidates.title: Hydra-0: Action Flow for Generalist World Modeling and Control

embodied_relevance.evidence: Action-flow-conditioned world model supports robot prediction, policy evaluation and inverse robot control.

primary_source.evidence: Official full text and project page were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Represents heterogeneous robot actions as shared pixel motion and discovers an inverse mode from desired object flow to executable action.

claim_support.evidence: Cross-embodiment/backbone experiments, RoboLab 300-episode policy evaluation and real cloth-folding proof of concept.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, generalization, evaluation, inverse mode and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: Hydra-0用像素运动作为跨embodiment动作接口，使同一世界模型支持预测、开放环策略评测和从人类物体flow反推动作。RoboLab上重放与真实成功率相关系数0.96，但当前闭环和真机验证仍有限。
risks_or_uncertainties: 当前主要是开放环评测
真机腕部相机仅定性proof of concept
未找到官方代码直链

candidates.title: FetchMan: Learning Visual Humanoid Loco-Manipulation Policies from Simulated Experiences

asset_checks.note: Project links repository but API returned 404; treat as not currently verified.

embodied_relevance.evidence: Visual humanoid loco-manipulation transfers zero-shot from simulation to a physical Unitree G1.

primary_source.evidence: Official full text and project page were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Shows synthetic behavior cloning saturates, then uses sparse-reward Flow-GRPO to exceed the demonstrator ceiling.

claim_support.evidence: More than 150,000 scenes, scale studies, RL ablations and zero-shot real G1 trials.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Pipeline, scaling, RL, real transfer, ablations and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: FetchMan给出一个有价值的负结论：增加合成示范无法突破BC上限，而从足够强的BC初始化进行Flow-GRPO可把仿真成功率从67%推到83%，并零样本部署Unitree G1。
risks_or_uncertainties: 任务主要限于fetch/reach-and-pick
真机试验数量有限且多物体结果以定性为主
项目所列仓库当前API返回404

candidates.title: H2R-Bench: Benchmarking Human-to-Robot Manipulation Video Generation in World Models

asset_checks.note: Dataset button is commented out with placeholder ORG/H2R-Bench.

embodied_relevance.evidence: Evaluates conversion of human manipulation videos into robot-embodiment training videos.

primary_source.evidence: Official full text, project and repository were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Scores task goals, action events, functional contact, embodiment correctness and video quality rather than appearance alone.

claim_support.evidence: Eleven video models, six manipulation families, two robot embodiments, 120 source tasks and bootstrap confidence intervals.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Dataset, metrics, model comparison, statistics and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: H2R-Bench首次系统诊断视频模型能否把人类示范转成指定机器人embodiment的视频，分开评估目标、动作事件、功能接触和机器人形态。当前模型在接触和任务执行上仍明显不足。
risks_or_uncertainties: 只评估可见证据，不验证物理可执行性或下游策略收益
仅120个源视频和两个目标embodiment
数据集按钮仍是占位符

candidates.title: PRISM: Precision and contact-rich Real-world Industrial Skill dataset with Multimodal sensing
organizations: Hubei Humanoid Robot Innovation Center Co., Ltd.

embodied_relevance.evidence: Real industrial contact-rich robot data with force, tactile, RGB-D and state sensing.

primary_source.evidence: Official full text, project and repository were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Targets precision industrial tasks under contact and dynamic constraints largely missing from household datasets.

claim_support.evidence: More than 25 tasks, 5,000 trajectories, 45 hours, multiple teleoperation modalities and real-robot policy evaluations.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Collection, modalities, baselines, teleoperation comparison and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: PRISM补足家庭数据偏重低接触短任务的空白，提供25+工业任务、5,000+轨迹和45小时同步RGB-D、力/力矩、触觉与状态。基线仍在动态操作和精密力控上明显失败，数据的研究问题清晰。
risks_or_uncertainties: 仓库可访问但数据下载完整性仍需人工复核
整体策略表现仍较低
工业平台与传感器成本可能限制复现

candidates.title: Reflex: Enabling Fast and Predictive Vision-Language-Action Models for Reaction-Critical Manipulation

embodied_relevance.evidence: Reaction-critical manipulation benchmark and VLA with real robot validation.

primary_source.evidence: Official full text and project page were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Jointly studies anticipatory latent prediction, temporal fusion and measured inference latency in dynamic tasks.

claim_support.evidence: Six tasks, 150 episodes per task across three seeds, static LIBERO checks, system ablations and three real tasks.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Benchmark, model, latency studies, real experiments and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: ReflexBench把仿真步进与机器人控制解耦，从而受控研究推理延迟；ReflexVLA将latent future prediction、时序融合与CUDA优化结合，并在三项真机动态任务验证。
risks_or_uncertainties: 代码承诺接收后发布，当前不可用
预测模块只在finetuning引入，未验证大规模预训练
只比较同步与基础异步两类推理机制

candidates.title: LIBERO-VIFO: Benchmarking the Capability and Safety of Visual Cue Following in Vision-Language-Action Models

embodied_relevance.evidence: Evaluates VLA execution under authorized and unauthorized visual cues in LIBERO manipulation.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Separates cue understanding, authorized following and unsafe unauthorized following across eight cue families.

claim_support.evidence: Four protocols and multiple models show both capability and safety failure modes.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Benchmark, protocols, results and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: LIBERO-VIFO补充了VLA视觉提示的授权/未授权边界，但证据仍局限LIBERO，且无项目和代码资产；适合作为安全专题常规收录，不与ManiGuard同级。
risks_or_uncertainties: 只有仿真
视觉提示行为可能来自场景捷径而非真正理解
无公开资产和已确认团队信息

candidates.title: DreamX-Phi 1.0: Action-Conditioned Video World Model for Robotic Manipulation

asset_checks.note: API verification was interrupted; retry before publication.

embodied_relevance.evidence: Action-conditioned video world model for robot manipulation and policy training.

primary_source.evidence: Official full text and linked repository were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Adds per-arm SE(3) encoding, depth and object-centric supervision to improve action and geometry fidelity.

claim_support.evidence: WorldArena 2.0/1.0 evaluation and downstream Adjust Bottle policy training provide system-level evidence.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Model, benchmark, leaderboard results and limitations were read.

risks_or_uncertainties: Track 2仅一个任务
没有真机验证
完整系统得分无法隔离PRoPE、depth和mask各自贡献
